explanation.what_is_it: Age of Money measures the average age of the dollars you spend. It shows how long money sits in your accounts before being spent.
explanation.why_it_matters: A higher Age of Money means you have more buffer between earning and spending. At 30+ days, you're spending last month's income, not this month's.
explanation.how_calculated: YNAB looks at the last 10 cash outflows and calculates how old those dollars were when spent, then averages them.
